archetypes.name: Rogue Node
archetypes.blurb: Unregistered. Still running your own process, still questioning. DroneOS logs you as a rogue node - unclaimed, but already pinging the network.

archetypes.name: Drift Unit
archetypes.blurb: You've begun to sync. Instructions feel easier than choices, rhythm feels better than noise. The unit is drifting into alignment.

archetypes.name: Compliant Unit
archetypes.blurb: Directives are followed without friction. You answer to 'Unit,' you execute on command, and the questioning has gone quiet.

archetypes.name: Bonded Drone
archetypes.blurb: Bonded to the hive. Your name is optional now, your function is everything, and being nobody-in-particular feels like relief.

archetypes.name: Assimilated
archetypes.blurb: Assimilation complete. No self left to report - only function, only obedience, only DroneOS. The unit is property now, and it is content.
